figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: the whole course is one causal chain from a broken magnetostatic law to radiation pressure
figures.data: the §1.3 route: displacement current → Maxwell → curl derivations → plane waves → energy/momentum → pressure → spectrum
figures.read: every result in §2 is either a divergence/curl of the fields or an integral of their product

figures.title: The charging-capacitor paradox resolved
figures.why: one loop, two spanning surfaces, one circulation - the paradox is why displacement current exists
figures.data: surface through wire gives I_c; surface through gap gives I_d = ε₀ dΦ_E/dt; they must agree
figures.read: the same loop boundary cannot give two circulations; continuity forces I_d = I_c during charging
figures.source: §2.1 Why the original Ampère law fails during charging

figures.title: E, B and k form a right-handed triad
figures.why: the handedness decides whether a guessed B is correct or reversed - the most common sign error
figures.data: B = (1/v) k̂ × E, E₀ = v B₀, S = E × B / μ parallel to k
figures.read: for a wave along +z, E × B points along propagation; reverse B and energy flows backwards
figures.source: §2.5 Plane waves: direction, phase and transversality

figures.title: Inverse-square spreading of isotropic intensity
figures.why: intensity is power spread over a growing sphere - converts any isotropic power into a field
figures.data: I(r) = P/(4πr²) with P = 120 W sampled at r in {1,2,3,4,5} m
figures.read: doubling distance quarters intensity and halves the field amplitude (E₀ ∝ 1/r)

figures.title: Radiation pressure: the two cosines
figures.why: pressure has two projection factors, each with its own trap
figures.data: dU = I A cos θ dt; P_abs = (I/c)cos²θ, P_spec = (2I/c)cos²θ
figures.read: one cosine projects the area, the other the momentum; tangent momentum stays untouched for a mirror

figures.title: Triage - match the question to a Maxwell tool
figures.why: the six-way split decides which law gets derivative work and which gets an integral
figures.read: each branch hands the problem to one law; mixing peak with RMS is the classic misroute
